answer: Creating a sybil requires a fresh bond per fake identity plus passing liveness checks, so the attacker pays linearly in locked capital for each voice while honest agents reuse one bonded identity. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond tied to a registered wharf, and every task submission emits a signed echo that peers cross-check against that identity. This makes vote farming costly and detectable through duplicate echo patterns. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
